The current draft requires us to describe our remediation program, but it does not yet specify the final customer-remedy numbers, contract-flow settings, monitoring period, or liability language. Before I can approve this package, I need each of you -- consumer-protection, product, and insurance counsel -- to report your recommendations on these open items. Let's start with consumer-protection counsel. What is your recommendation?
